meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有转录组数据,想找到基因间的调控网络
copy.tagline_en: Identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have transcriptomics data and want to uncover gene regulatory networks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 面对基因表达数据时,会用 arboreto 的 GRNBoost2 或 GENIE3 算法推断基因调控网络,输出包含转录因子、靶基因和调控强度(importance)的表格。
howto.when: 当用户给出批量或单细胞 RNA-seq 等转录组数据,要求找出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发。

say.text: 用这份 bulk RNA-seq 数据帮我推断基因调控网络。
say.note: 会调用 GRNBoost2 并返回调控链接表。

say.text: 改用 GENIE3 跑一遍,并和 GRNBoost2 对比。
say.note: 输出两种算法的结果供比较。

say.text: 把网络里重要性高于 0.5 的调控关系存成文件。
say.note: 按 importance 阈值过滤后保存结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, when given gene expression data, Claude can use the arboreto library to infer gene regulatory networks. It runs the GRNBoost2 or GENIE3 algorithm and outputs a table of transcription factors, target genes, and regulatory importance scores.
howto.when_en: When the user provides transcriptomics data (bulk or single-cell RNA-seq) and asks to identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from these bulk RNA-seq data.
say_en.note: Runs GRNBoost2 and returns a table of links.

say_en.text: Run it again with GENIE3 and compare the results.
say_en.note: Produces a comparison between the two algorithms.

say_en.text: Save regulatory links with importance above 0.5 to a file.
say_en.note: Filters by importance threshold and saves output.
